name: Healthcare Clinic
description: Starter pack for clinic and medical office administration: sterilization logs, equipment checks, supply control and license renewals.

definitions.title: Daily sterilization cycle log
definitions.note: Run and record the autoclave cycles with results.
steps: File the strip or digital record

definitions.title: Daily fridge and vaccine temperature log
definitions.note: Record fridge, freezer and vaccine storage temperatures twice a day.

definitions.title: Weekly autoclave spore test
definitions.note: Send the weekly biological indicator and file the result.

definitions.title: Weekly supply count
definitions.note: Count consumables and place the supplier order.

definitions.title: Monthly expiry check
definitions.note: Check medications and supplies for expiring stock and rotate.

definitions.title: Monthly equipment calibration check
definitions.note: Verify calibration stickers on clinical equipment.

definitions.title: Quarterly emergency kit drill
definitions.note: Check emergency kits, oxygen and defibrillator readiness.

definitions.title: Staff CPR recertification
definitions.note: Book CPR recertification for all clinical staff before expiry.

definitions.title: Clinic license renewal
definitions.note: Renew the clinic license and display the new certificate.

definitions.title: Biohazard waste contract review
definitions.note: Review the biohazard waste disposal contract and compliance reports.

definitions.title: Monthly patient feedback review
definitions.note: Review feedback and complaints and decide follow-ups.

definitions.title: Ad-hoc equipment repair
definitions.note: One-off equipment repair or service call - set the due date when creating it.
